svg.title: AWS Cloud Mindmap — AWS Master Vault — 14 named domains and 120 catalogue topics
svg.desc: Named AWS architecture domains from cloud foundations to AI engineering. Every domain uses an official AWS architecture service icon and a topic grid; no alphabetic category markers. Created by Rahul Tripathi.
svg.text: A PRACTICAL GUIDE TO AWS MASTER VAULT
